disposition_reason: Waste-treatment engineering; selenium is a process additive, not a food or human exposure measure.

study.design: batch biomethane potential experiments on synthetic food waste with trace element supplementation
study.method: batch anaerobic digestion assays; trace element analysis of feedstock

non_numeric_findings: Selenate at 25 to 50 ug/L raised biomethane production by 30 to 35% regardless of feedstock (Abstract).
Synthetic food waste prepared in Tampa had 1.3 +/- 0.5 ug/g total solids selenium; Delft feedstock was below detection (Abstract).
